solution_summary: Opap rolled out Microsoft 365 across its Microsoft 365 estate because OPAP, Greece's leading gaming company, was one of the first companies globally to integrate Microsoft Copilot to transform its daily workflows. Users work inside applications such as Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot for Microsoft 365, and Microsoft Teams, where the assistant can summarize meetings and email, draft documents, surface answers from existing files and conversations, and help employees move from context gathering to action without switching tools. Rather than building a separate chatbot, the organization grounded AI in the same collaboration data, permissions, and operational workflows that staff already use every day, which keeps adoption and governance aligned. The result is a reusable productivity layer for knowledge work and service delivery, and With Copilot's introduction, OPAP aims to save time and automate routine tasks, as well as make meetings more actionable, efficient, and quick.
